Analyze the following external review feedback and check how it was addressed.
You have tools available — use `git diff origin/main...HEAD -- ':(exclude).planwerk'` to see ALL changes on this feature branch. You can also read individual files.

- "resolution_summary": A concise summary (2-4 sentences) of what was done overall to address the review.
- "comment_resolutions": An array of strings, one per code comment (in the same order), each describing what was changed at that location. If there are no code comments, return an empty array.

IMPORTANT: If changes were made to files or locations NOT directly mentioned in the review feedback, the resolution_summary MUST explicitly list these additional changes and explain WHY they were necessary (e.g., 'Applied new pattern X from reviewer comment to N additional matching locations: [list files]'). [1] images/python-base/Dockerfile:17: **`tzdata` install may prompt without `DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive`**

`tzdata` is known to present interactive prompts for geographic area and timezone when installed via `apt-get` if `DEBIAN_FRONTEND` is not set. Docker builds have no TTY, so `tzdata` usually defaults to UTC without hanging, but the behaviour is environment-dependent and has caused silent build failures on some CI runners. Setting `DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive` for the duration of this `RUN` step makes the behaviour explicit and portable.

```suggestion
RUN DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates \
    netbase \
    python3 \
    sudo \
    tzdata \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
```
